statusHistory.note: San Francisco Bay Area Tier 1 cluster, near-batch-30 run 2026-09-07-batch-30. Sourcing and identity confirmed in a prior session (10 10th St, Oakland — reopened January 24, 2026 after a 20-year closure and $100M renovation; five distinct venues inside: an arena, the 1,500-seat Calvin Simmons Theatre, a speakeasy lounge, and two ballrooms): CBS News, ABC7, Oaklandside (two pieces, including balanced coverage of a live IATSE Local 107 stagehand-union contract dispute, not omitted), Wikipedia, Visit Oakland. No dedupe conflict per check-duplicates.mjs. Previously blocked because the official site's og:image was a wordmark rather than a photo. This session resolved the hero-image gate with a tier-1 real photo: a landscape (4032x3024) exterior shot of the building — then still called Kaiser Convention Center — on Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0, credited to Pi.1415926535. The building's exterior is unchanged by the interior-focused 2026 renovation, confirmed by comparing the photo's facade/signage against current news coverage of the reopened venue. Coordinates are the Wikimedia photo's own recorded GPS location for the building, cross-checked against the venue's published 10 10th St address.
